Supreme Court Issues Contempt Notice to Sanjay Raut and Nikhil Wagle

The Supreme Court of India has issued contempt notices to Shiv Sena (UBT) Member of Parliament Sanjay Raut and journalist Nikhil Wagle concerning remarks made about the Chief Justice of India (CJI) and the judiciary. The court asked Sanjay Raut to explain his conduct in relation to a plea regarding the electoral roll (SIR). While hearing the matter, the Supreme Court also entertained a plea related to the INDIA bloc. Patrika reported that Sanjay Raut sought an apology from the CJI regarding his remarks on the electoral roll issue and expressed hope for justice.
